title: Automate batch compression of remaining completed target artifacts
changes: Add cold_storage.py batch --apply to discover and compress remaining eligible completed artifacts in one invocation, with a 1 MiB default minimum, optional preview, additional path exclusions and per-run progress receipts.

Reuse existing completion receipts without executing tests, builds, gameplay or benchmarks. Recognize successful legacy exit-code lists and Windows result records, reject conflicting failures and preserve current/shared/private/suspended or explicitly hot paths.

Reuse verified streamed archives and original-path restoration. Bind original result hashes and source metadata, hold store/scope leases, check host consumers and completion evidence before retirement, and stop interrupted publications for review. Reruns skip cataloged paths and leave manually restored copies available.

Apply the batch to 272 additional paths in 142 completed scopes: 11409207296 original file-block bytes became 1876983808 compressed payload bytes plus 153452544 metadata bytes, reclaiming 9378770944 bytes (8.73 GiB / 9.38 GB).
validation: Automatic discovery selected 272 additional paths totaling 10.63 GiB from existing results; CLI help and Python syntax parsing passed.

Application receipt target/cold-storage-batches/20261107-113755-51f0fa64/batch.json PASS: all 272 selected archives completed, no errors; archive contents verified by the existing pack operation before originals were retired.

completion-audit.json PASS: all 272 catalog-manifest hashes and archived states verified, retired source paths absent, all 6426 prior private-file identity/size/mtime guards unchanged. No repeated payload scan, restoration exercise or runtime validation.
Three unreadable host process details remain recorded in archive proofs; source/tool hashes and observed disk-free space are recorded separately without attributing unrelated disk changes.
limitations: No test suite, game build, gameplay or benchmark was run for this storage-maintenance request. Native Windows archival remains unverified.

Unrecognized or conflicting historical result receipts require separate review; canonical Cargo outputs, current datasets, private inputs and unresolved work are intentionally excluded. The command is invoked explicitly and does not install a background service.
Host process-detail denials are retained in archive proofs; no global host inactivity is claimed. Savings exclude external batch receipts and filesystem directory metadata.
